capabilities: pin the selected word or the word under the cursor
keep multiple pins per note with word, line and time
jump to a pin from the sidebar pin list
delete single pins or all pins in a note
re-find the pinned word after edits when the line has moved
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Install is via BRAT or manual file copy from a GitHub release; a separate UPLOAD-TO-GITHUB.md covers publishing steps. Pins are stored in the plugin data file and never modify the Markdown text.
problem: Obsidian has no way to mark several words inside a long note and quickly return to each one later.

relations.evidence: Add that command to the mobile toolbar: Settings → Mobile → configure toolbar (or use the Commander plugin).

summary: Word-pin navigation tool that pins words or phrases in long notes and jumps back to them from a sidebar list, storing pin word, line and time.
